response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack engineer with strong software craftsmanship credentials, but his career has been overwhelmingly focused on TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and web technologies. Java appears only briefly and superficially (robotic arms, mobile orchestration tooling) alongside DLang years ago, Kotlin is entirely absent, and there is no evidence of Spring, JVM internals expertise, or IDE tooling experience despite one C IDE role in C/C++. This is a significant mismatch against the core required qualifications of deep Java/Kotlin/JVM and Spring ecosystem expertise.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level experience across diverse tech stacks and industries
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, testing tools, workshops/talks)
Prior IDE-adjacent experience (C/C++ components for a commercial IDE)
concerns: No Kotlin experience mentioned anywhere in resume
Java experience is minimal, dated, and never paired with Spring/enterprise frameworks
No evidence of JVM internals depth, language tooling, or application server integration work

key_factors.factor: Missing Kotlin and Spring ecosystem experience
General software engineering seniority and craftsmanship
